asr.full_text: As streaming services and websites continue to grow so will the growing pains that come with the consoles. As consoles slowly become more PC like in architecture, style, and what they do so do the applications. and this all comes together in a socialization kind of sphere that has the chances of Popping as quickly as a balloon in a room full of pins all facing Upward in the Direction the Balloon is falling Sony is apparently cutting ties with Ustream on PlayStation 4 in August. This is due to the simple fact that the PlayStation administration, Sony, and the lawnmower outside that is interrupting my broadcast, has decided to stop the Ustream ability on PlayStation 4. Now now I don't know If nintendo, the nx, microsoft, xbox one, wii u and another devices from other companies would deal with USTREAM but this is a result of bad information, bad stuff happening. this is a little bit of an issue because if you think about it, you have a company over here. Ustream. And they're not getting their app on the PlayStation 4. One of the biggest companies that is involved in gaming. One of the three big ones and now you're kind of ask so well as a streaming service because you have other competition from livestream periscope I know periscope is not gaming oriented but still you have stuff from twitch YouTube Dailymotion even you have other streaming websites as well I stream on HiPbox personally uuh because I seriously don't like Twitch they ban whoever the fuck they want and give partnerships to whoever the fuck they want even if these individuals do not qualify for them or do qualify for them they deny and approve them So I don't really like that type of game that Twitch plays personally and I went over to hitbox myself so it's kind of odd that these competition websites these competition streaming websites are getting the kibosh from different things it's not good for the consumer either because you really want a choice YouTube gaming and Twitch that's great uh before youtube gaming there wasn't really another streaming website that competed at such a high level as twitch but it was still potentially there as the lawnmower does another pass thank you thank you for weighing in on the conversation lawnmower maybe the guys playing lawnmowers Maybe the guys playing that lawn mower game that was available on PC who knows because we'll never know because he's using you streaming a PlayStation 4 It would just seem that they're doing favor for Twitch and YouTube they're putting all their eggs in that basket The problem with that is, even if the consoles are so good, they still can not be competitive with people to use. and again, when people say that consoles are just lower end PC's, they are, but they aren't the same time. Because with a decent PC I can use any type of streaming service. I wouldn't have to be dependent on Ustream at Sony or anything like that this is going to be happening August 1st 2016 as the result PlayStation users won't be able to use a number of features from the service which is very unfortunate you won't be able to view a broadcast and you won't be able to upload your own broadcast for any playstation devices which is yeah kind of sad man competition is dying out in favor of twitch and YouTube gaming so what do you guys think the use you stream I think the lawnmower uses you stream it's coming by again to put in it's two cents I will see what's going to happen in the future with a lot of these streaming services and I've been your host proto Mario and I'm signing up as always good gaming and God bless
